description: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance over six training epochs for different quantization configurations during fine-tuning of the Whisper “tiny” model, as part of an abstractive summarization pipeline from audio transcription. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks, indicating discrete training epochs. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 25 to 70, with major gridlines at intervals of 5, representing the word error rate as a percentage. Five distinct lines are plotted: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (solid gray line with circle markers) starts at ~69 WER and steadily declines to ~40; “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (solid dark gray line with square markers) begins at ~60 and drops to ~32; “tiny int4” (dashed gray line with circle markers) starts at ~60 and decreases to ~39; “tiny int8” (dashed dark gray line with square markers) begins at ~47 and falls to ~37; and “tiny” (dotted light gray line with triangle markers) remains relatively flat, starting at ~29 and ending at ~23. All lines show a general downward trend in WER over epochs, with the full-precision “tiny” model consistently achieving the lowest error rate throughout training.
